bundle.shortDescription: Search your screenshots by what's in them.
bundle.longDescription: Screenlabel makes your screenshots findable. Each one gets described and indexed locally, so you can search by what you remember seeing. Every screenshot keeps a plain Markdown sidecar file you own, on your own disk. Runs on your own OpenAI key — no account, no server.
